scientific_integrity: One complete claim with an all-alphabet mathematical proof. Binary order two is handled separately. Verifiers are finite checks; originality remains subject to unindexed-prior-work risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact for blocklength four and at most one directed predecessor overwrite. The result does not address arbitrary blocklengths, multiple smears, or physical noise models. The general construction uses the classical existence of idempotent Latin squares.
title: Exact length-four single-grain capacity over every finite alphabet
